p: Prose after it: no blank line and no empty paragraph is left behind.
Prose whose citation sits directly underneath it, no blank line before the comment.
Content wrapped by DocuMe's own refresh markers survives; the markers do not.
Text with an comment keeps the author's spacing verbatim.
A comment may also trail a sentence.
